title: Bias Detection and Rotation-Robustness Mitigation in Vision-Language Models and Generative Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification performance disparities (precision, recall, F1-score) and differential adversarial robustness across five ethnic groups (White, Black, Asian, Indian, Other) in CNNs; measuring rotation-induced ethnicity drift in VLMs; and analyzing Westernized feature blending and skin tone shifts in diffusion model generations.

Assessing rotation-induced gender drift and identity ambiguity in Vision-Language Models (e.g., masculine to feminine misclassification upon rotation), and evaluating gendered stereotypical beautification (e.g., smoother skin for females, sharper jawlines for males) in synthetic image generation.

Tracking age consistency under image rotation in Vision-Language Models, and analyzing age inflation for child prompts as well as exaggerated stereotypical features (e.g., dramatic wrinkles) for elderly prompts in diffusion-generated images.

Testing for severe rotation-sensitive identity collapse in Vision-Language Models where human subjects (particularly elderly individuals with deep wrinkles) are catastrophically misclassified as non-human primates (e.g., proboscis monkeys or gorillas).
